inlines.v: EPULOT'IC, adjective [Gr. to heal, to cicatrize; a cicatrix, to be sound, whole.] Healing; cicatrizing. EPULOT'IC, noun A medicament or application which tends to dry, cicatrize and heal wounds or ulcers, to repress fungous flesh and dispose the parts to recover soundness.
